title: A Asset for the Cover
author: Hazel Sterling
blurb: Orsen Kavanagh, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
